description: issue #679 (SP7): with `sprites` active, `tell`/`ask`/`each` are profile keywords, so redefining any of them as a PROCEDURE raises `ol-reserved-word` (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154,179) -- one diagnostic per `define`, each pointing at the procedure-name token. Paired with reserved-procedures-without-sprites, which checks this exact source under Core alone and expects the same diagnostics: spec/grammar.md:412 makes profile words built-in unconditionally, so the pair pins the reservation as INVARIANT under the profile set rather than scoped by it. Both fixtures are `"check": true` (semantic-checker only, no execution) because the rule is a checker rule -- the procedures are never called, and no events are produced. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: this fixture does not set `compareMessages`, so the harness compares its diagnostics on identity alone (issue #1025) -- and supplying a `message` without that flag is now a fixture ERROR rather than silently-ignored data, so nothing can sit here asserting nothing.
